name: IB Collaboration VR
summary:
IB Collaboration VR enables teams, customers and partners to work together in immersive virtual environments.

Use interactive 3D spaces for workshops, training sessions, presentations, events and collaborative project work. Participants can meet regardless of location, interact naturally and visualize complex topics in a highly engaging way.

The platform enhances digital collaboration by creating a strong sense of presence that goes far beyond traditional video conferencing.
